body.x: Metapia (CEO Seung-ik Jeong) announced its participation in CES 2025 from January 7 to 10 in Las Vegas. The company will introduce its groundbreaking AI idol, Lina, at the K-Startup Pavilion.

Metapia, a dynamic content startup, comprises a diverse team ranging from high school graduates to PhD holders, with an average employee age of 28. This youthful perspective enables the company to rapidly adapt to trends and reflect them in its content offerings.

Metapia’s AI idol Lina, developed using cutting-edge technology, has redefined fan interactions, creating a new frontier in the entertainment industry. The company is also recognized for its metaverse platform solutions, which support digital transformation for businesses and, in partnership with government agencies, contribute to the growth of South Korea’s metaverse industry.

Metapia has received accolades such as the Minister of Science and ICT Award and the Minister of Culture, Sports, and Tourism Award, underscoring its technological expertise and societal impact. With over 90 B2B and B2G clients and a growing audience of more than 300,000 followers, Metapia has established itself as a leader in metaverse-driven solutions across diverse industries.

At CES 2025, Metapia will debut Lina, an AI-powered virtual idol with advanced motion recognition and real-time interaction capabilities. In addition to music and dance performances, Lina offers interactive engagement with fans, presenting new opportunities for the entertainment industry.

Key features include natural conversation capabilities enabled by voice recognition and text analysis technologies. Lina is designed for use across various platforms, including the metaverse, social media, and broadcasting. Multilingual support and customized content offerings also allow Lina to become a global idol and foster connections with fans worldwide.

AVING News, which has covered CES for 19 consecutive years, continues to bridge the gap for Korean SMEs and startups looking to expand globally. To promote Korean startups worldwide, AVING will host its Broadcasting Zone at the Venetian Expo, featuring the CES Media Day Startup Conference and global media interviews. AVING’s international media partners will cover these programs.
Following CES 2025, AVING will co-host review conferences with participating companies in Korea, offering a platform for increased visibility and improved corporate image.
